release_name: Live TV v5.2.1 (Build 56) — Watch Live Sports Multi-Server Failover
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🎾 Live Sports 'Watch Live' Instant Play & Multi-Server Resilience: Fixed live sports event tuning so clicking '▶ Watch Live' or event cards plays instantly across macOS, Android, and Web without blank/black screens

🛡️ Intelligent Multi-Server Failover: Direct match streams (FanCode / live feeds) now automatically attach verified 24/7 backup sports broadcast feeds (Tennis Channel HD Amagi CDN, T2 Live, beIN Sports XTRA, T Sports HD, Red Bull MotoGP) with zero-delay auto-failover on HTTP 403 / 404 / geo-blocking
🔒 Secure HTTPS & Mixed Content Elimination: Replaced legacy HTTP sports streams with CORS-enabled HTTPS feeds to ensure flawless playback in web browsers and native app webviews
⇄ Last Channel Toggle & Recall: Alternates between current and previous channels with on-screen button labels and hotkey Q
👆 Player Controls Touch & Scroll Lock: Touching or scrolling through action pills and channels will never hide controls overlay
🎚️ Web Audio Lip-Sync Offset: Real-time delay compensation (-500ms to +1500ms)
🔍 In-Player Spotlight Channel Search (/): Instant modal HUD search across all 2,989+ channels without exiting fullscreen
🔔 Live Sports Match Reminders: Set alerts on upcoming matches with synthesized chime and 1-click tune
🔎 Custom Video Zoom & Pan: Multi-level zoom with touch pinch and drag-to-pan
